data.title: M&T takes ‘patient’ approach to M&A, CFO says
data.body: The Buffalo, New York-based regional has “a specific number of candidates that we're talking to” but an acquisition “will happen when it happens,” M&T CFO Daryl Bible said Tuesday.

data.title: VLY Stock Rallies 3.9% as Q1 Earnings Beat on Higher NII & Fee Income
data.body: Valley National jumps 3.9% after Q1 earnings beat on higher NII and fee income, with revenue growth and lower provisions offsetting rising expenses.

data.title: Huntington Stock Gains as Q1 Earnings Top on Higher NII & Fee Income
data.body: HBAN stock rises after Q1 earnings beat as higher NII and fee income drive growth, despite rising expenses, higher provisions and weaker credit quality.

data.title: CBSH Q1 Earnings Beat as Revenues Rise Y/Y, Stock Dips on Higher Costs
data.body: Commerce Bancshares Q1 earnings beat on revenue growth and loan gains, but rising expenses and weaker profitability ratios push shares lower.
